# Episode 1: The First Echo — 15-Second Chunk Breakdown

*Condensed ~5-minute pacing pass: the script re-broken into exactly 20 chunks of 15 seconds each (00:00–05:00).*

---

## COLD OPEN — EXT. LUMINA — MARKET DISTRICT — DAY

**00:00–00:15** — Establishing Lumina: transit rings, terraced garden-blocks, glass-and-light architecture. Ordinary Tuesday. Noa (12) weaves through the market stalls, amber-gold eyes cataloguing everything; two hair clips (tarnished gold, cracked blue) in her messy black hair.

**00:15–00:30** — A fruit-seller's hand closes on empty air — his coin is gone. Noa clocks a wrong flicker at the plaza's edge, translucent and sluggish; no one else can see it. NOA: "Okay. That's new." SMASH CUT TO TITLE: **THE KEEPERS**.

---

## ACT ONE

### EXT. LUMINA — MARKET DISTRICT — CONTINUOUS

**00:30–00:45** — Noa charges the shape — fists, a dropped crate, a shout — nothing works.

**00:45–01:00** — OMNI's city-wide chime cuts through. The fog-shape flinches at the words and flees.

### INT. NOA & LIOR'S APARTMENT — NIGHT

**01:00–01:15** — Home, unsettled. Lior deflects Noa's questions about her missing mother Sena with tea and an old tin box she won't open.

**01:15–01:30** — A comm-chime interrupts. AREN fills the screen.

**01:30–01:45** — Aren's procedural composure cracks, softening.

**01:45–02:00** — NOA: "Some doors are locked for a reason. Which is exactly why I open them."

---

## ACT TWO

### EXT. LUMINA — OLD FLOOD-LINE — NIGHT / INT. THE VAULT — ANTECHAMBER

**02:00–02:15** — Noa slips through a service grate she's clearly used before.

**02:15–02:30** — She reaches out — the gold clip catches the indigo light.

### INT. MEMORY: THE DEEP SECTOR ACCESS TUNNEL — NIGHT

**02:30–02:45** — Damp stone, a hand-lamp's narrow cone of light. SENA works a rockfall loose.

**02:45–03:00** — SENA: "You don't have to see the whole way. You just have to see the next step."

**03:00–03:10** — As the memory frays, Sena's head tilts. The tunnel dissolves into golden static.

### INT. THE VAULT — ANTECHAMBER — CONTINUOUS

**03:10–03:25** — Noa jolts back into her own body, gasping. Her hand begins to glow.

---

## ACT THREE — EXT. LUMINA — MARKET DISTRICT — NIGHT

**03:25–03:40** — The Regret has grown. Noa arrives at a run.

**03:40–03:55** — Her palm meets the fog — contact floods her with the borrowed memory.

**03:55–04:10** — NOA: "You don't have to see the whole way back — just the next step."

**04:10–04:25** — The Regret goes still, then comes apart, dissolving into drifting gold light.

---

## TAG

### INT. NOA & LIOR'S APARTMENT — KITCHEN — LATER, NIGHT

**04:25–04:40** — Noa slips in, the brass doorknob hidden in her jacket; Lior's waiting with two fresh cups of tea.

### INT. SKY-SPIRE — SURVEILLANCE FLOOR — NIGHT

**04:40–04:50** — Cold glass and pale steel. DIRECTOR CASSIAN VALE watches a looping feed. VALE: "There you are."

**04:50–05:00** — VALE: "Reassign our star cadet." FADE OUT.

**END OF EPISODE 1** — condensed to 5:00 (300 seconds) across 20 chunks.
